name: dawa-pharmacy
description: Dawa — pharmacy management system (POS, inventory, batches, purchasing, prescriptions, finance)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
